detailed_description: Tweet Generator creates short Tweet/X post variants from a topic, tone, hashtag setting, call-to-action setting, and optional thread mode. The real component tracks the 280-character limit, marks near-limit drafts, and can generate single-post variants or a short thread. It does not connect to X/Twitter, schedule posts, fetch analytics, or guarantee engagement.
usage_steps: Enter the topic or idea for the post.
Choose the tone and whether to include hashtags or a call to action.
Optionally enable thread mode and select the number of thread tweets.
Review character counts, copy a draft, and edit it before posting.
usage_examples: Compare professional, humorous, motivational, question, and sharing tones.
Create a short thread outline from one topic idea.

faqs.question: Tweet Generator is free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool runs free in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The calculation or generation runs locally in the browser.

faqs.question: Does it post to X/Twitter?
faqs.answer: No. It only creates draft text that you copy and publish yourself.

faqs.question: Does it enforce the character limit?
faqs.answer: It shows character counts and status labels for the 280-character limit, but you should still review final text in the platform composer.
